title: Coaching Your Own World-Class Daughter: The Truth | Break the Routine with Lene James Mikkelsen
description:
Lene James Mikkelsen left university in Aarhus at 19 for London, where everyone told her that she and Colin James did not fit together. He was far too tall for her. Together they became world champions. She tells Marius Iepure what really happens when you coach your own world-class daughter, why she has tried more than once to hand Zia over to other teachers, and why she warns every dancing parent: "be careful what you wish for."

She opens up about losing her mum and pouring the grief into her dancing, why a man in DanceSport is "made for life" while a woman must keep proving herself, and what solo girls miss out on without a partner. Plus judging on instinct and questioning yourself afterwards, the ETC camp with a live band, the Skills and Drills book that was never printed, judging Vild med Dans, and why she is not sure democracy is always the best way to run DanceSport.

An honest conversation about sacrifice, high standards and what dance asks of you when it becomes your whole life.

Episode out now on YouTube.
